title: Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP) - Benazir Kafaalat
description: Pakistan's largest social safety net program. Unconditional quarterly cash transfer to over 9.3 million poorest households nationwide. Special focus on women as primary beneficiaries. Managed by Government of Pakistan.
address: BISP Headquarters, Islamabad, Pakistan (Multiple offices across all provinces)
support: Quarterly Cash Transfer (Rs. 14,500 per quarter as of March 2026)
Benazir Nashonuma Programme (Nutrition support for mothers/infants)
No loan required - free financial help
Registration in all provinces and territories
eligibility: Households with monthly income below Rs. 25,000 (approximate)
Determined by Proxy Means Test (PMT) scoring
Preference given to families with children
All provinces covered (Punjab, Sindh, KP, Balochistan, GB, AJK)
application: Send CNIC to 8171 via SMS (free) to check eligibility. Also check at bisp.gov.pk or 8171.bisp.gov.pk portal. Registration ongoing - no fixed deadline. Visit nearest BISP center for detailed assistance.
source_name: Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP) - Government of Pakistan

title: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal (PBM) - Individual Financial Assistance (IFA)
description: Federal government welfare organization providing financial assistance to poor, widows, disabled, and orphans. Offers one-time grants for general assistance, medical treatment, education, and rehabilitation. Maximum Rs. 30,000 per individual.
address: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal Headquarters, Islamabad (District offices in all districts)
phone_number: Available at local District Bait-ul-Mal Committee offices
support: Priority for widows, disabled, and destitute
Support for families with multiple disabled members
eligibility: No regular assistance from other government programs
Priority categories: widows, disabled, destitute, orphans
Preference to those with no source of income
Must apply through District Committee of residence area
application: Apply to Chairman of District Bait-ul-Mal Committee in your area of permanent residence. Submit prescribed application form with supporting documents. Each application reviewed individually on first-come-first-basis.

title: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal - Educational Assistance for Deserving Students
description: Educational assistance program providing scholarships and stipends to deserving students studying in government educational institutions (schools, colleges, universities). Supports bright but financially needy students to continue their education.
address: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal Headquarters, Islamabad (Provincial and district offices)
phone_number: Available at educational institutions or District PBM offices
support: Support for BS (Hons) and Master programs
Direct fee payment to educational institution
eligibility: Must clear all subjects (failure makes ineligible for next year)
documents: CNIC (student if 18+, or parent CNIC if below 18)
Fee Challan/Fee Voucher for current semester
application: Download application form from educational institution. Submit to head of institution with bonafide certificate and fee documents. Cases processed through university/college committee, forwarded to PBM for final approval. No direct online application - must go through institution.

title: Ehsaas Emergency Cash Programme
description: Government of Pakistan emergency financial assistance for low-income families facing immediate financial hardship, inflation, unemployment, or economic crisis. One-time emergency payment of Rs. 14,000-25,000. Integrated with BISP system.
address: Ehsaas Program Office, Islamabad (coordinated through BISP)
phone_number: SMS 8171, Call BISP helpline, or visit 8171.pass.gov.pk
support: Bank transfer and ATM withdrawal options
eligibility: Families affected by inflation or financial crisis
No government job in immediate family
Not receiving large financial aid from other schemes
application: Send CNIC to 8171 SMS (free) for eligibility check. Check status at 8171.pass.gov.pk web portal. Enter CNIC and captcha code. Register at Ehsaas centers if needed. Assistance transfers directly to bank account or ATM.

title: Ehsaas Disabled Person Program
description: Government program providing monthly financial support to persons with disabilities. Rs. 2,000 monthly stipend to help cover basic expenses. Includes skill development and scholarship opportunities. Supported by BISP and Bait-ul-Mal funds.
address: Social Welfare Departments (federal and provincial), Ehsaas Program Offices
phone_number: Provincial Social Welfare Department hotlines, Ehsaas helpline
eligibility: Disability must be reflected in CNIC
20+ million families with disabled persons eligible
documents: Disability Certificate from Social Welfare Department
Medical assessment and disability board report
application: Register with Ehsaas or BISP program. Ensure disability status in CNIC. Apply at government Social Welfare Department office. Contact Ehsaas centers for assistance. NADRA verification required. Government funds transferred directly to bank account.
source_name: Ministry of Poverty Alleviation & Social Safety, Government of Pakistan

title: CM Punjab Himmat Card 2026 (Disability Support)
description: Punjab province program for persons with disabilities. Provides monthly stipends, free medical facilities, education support, and job opportunities. Special welfare card program for social inclusion and independent living.
address: Social Welfare Department Punjab offices across all districts
phone_number: Provincial Social Welfare Department hotline, District offices
application: Visit Social Welfare Department office in your district. Apply through online portal or physical application. Eligibility verified through CNIC and disability records. Card status checked via online portal with CNIC.
source_name: Social Welfare Department, Government of Punjab

title: CM Punjab Rahmat Card (Widow & Orphan Support) 2026
description: Punjab's comprehensive welfare program for widows and orphaned children. Rs. 5 billion allocated from Zakat Fund. Provides Rs. 100,000 one-time grant to eligible widows and orphans. Digital and transparent distribution system.
address: Zakat & Ushr Department Punjab, District Zakat Committees, Mobile App/Web Portal
phone_number: Helpline 1077 (Punjab Zakat & Ushr Dept), mobile app support
eligibility: Eligible for Zakat under Islamic Shariah
Not receiving regular financial assistance from other government schemes
application: Download and apply through dedicated Mobile App or Web Portal. Call helpline 1077 for guidance. Visit Zakat & Ushr Department office with documents. Biometric verification and field checks conducted. Funds directly transferred to bank account.
source_name: Zakat & Ushr Department, Government of Punjab

title: Punjab Bait-ul-Maal - Financial Assistance for Needy/Disabled
description: Separate Punjab provincial Bait-ul-Maal program. Provides one-time grants up to Rs. 30,000 for relief and rehabilitation of poor, disabled, and needy persons. Managed by District Bait-ul-Maal Committees.
address: District Bait-ul-Maal Committees (Punjab), headquartered in Lahore
phone_number: District Bait-ul-Maal Committee offices across Punjab
eligibility: Priority to disabled and needy persons
Not receiving Zakat or other major assistance
application: Apply at Chairman, District Bait-ul-Maal Committee in your area. Download application form from bm.punjab.gov.pk. Submit with supporting documents. Committee reviews financial circumstances and approves/rejects. Direct payment after approval.

title: Zakat Deduction from Bank Accounts (Automatic System)
description: Automatic Zakat deduction system from bank accounts by State Bank of Pakistan. Zakat collected from eligible accounts on deduction date (typically February). Funds distributed to eligible individuals under Islamic principles.
address: State Bank of Pakistan, all scheduled banks across Pakistan
phone_number: SBP Helpline, Individual bank customer service
support: Automatic Zakat deduction (2.5% of eligible wealth)
Support to poor and needy categories
Support for striving in cause of Allah
eligibility: Bank account holders with minimum balance Rs. 503,529 (2026 threshold)
Account maintained for one Islamic year
Savings, Profit/Loss Sharing, and similar accounts
documents: Zakat declaration (if opting for alternative calculation)
application: No application required. Automatic deduction by bank on deduction date (typically February 19-20). Can opt out or modify calculation. Check with bank for specific terms and conditions.

title: KP Ehsaas Umeed Card (Disability & Widow/Orphan Support)
description: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provincial program providing monthly stipends to persons with disabilities, widows, and orphans. Rs. 5,000 monthly through card-based system. Direct bank transfer, no paperwork.
address: Social Welfare Department KP, District Social Welfare Offices
phone_number: Provincial Social Welfare Department, District offices
support: Rs. 5,000 monthly for disabled persons (10,000 beneficiaries)
Rs. 5,000 monthly for widows and orphans
Ehsaas Scholarship for disabled students (Rs. 700 million)
application: Register through doorstep services or visit Social Welfare Department office. Registration conducted at applicant's home location. Direct bank account transfer initiated after verification. Monthly deposits automatic.
source_name: Social Welfare Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

title: Benazir Taleemi Wazaif (Education Stipends)
description: BISP sub-program providing conditional cash transfers to encourage school attendance. Additional stipends for BISP beneficiary families with school-age children. Increased by Rs. 500 in February 2026.
address: BISP Headquarters and provincial offices (coordinated through BISP)
support: Education stipends for primary school children
Education stipends for secondary school children
application: Automatic if already BISP beneficiary with school-age children. Enrollment in government school required. School provides attendance certificates. Payments made quarterly through BISP.
source_name: Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP) - Government of Pakistan

title: Benazir Nashonuma Programme (Nutrition Support)
description: BISP health and nutrition initiative supporting pregnant women, lactating mothers, and infants under 2 years. Prevents stunting and malnutrition. Increased stipends by Rs. 500 in February 2026.
phone_number: BISP helpline SMS 8171, health department offices
application: Automatic enrollment if BISP beneficiary with pregnancy/infant. Medical confirmation through health centers. Quarterly stipend payments made through BISP system.
source_name: Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP) - Government of Pakistan
